newsitem.title: CHINA: PHILIPS EYES CHINA MOBILE PHONE MARKET.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS EYES CHINA MOBILE PHONE MARKET.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV has announced plans to set up a $30 million joint venture with Shenzhen Sanda Electronics Co to produce telephones, mobile telephones and pagers, the China Economic News newsletter said on Thursday.
Philips aims to become one of the top three mobile telephone suppliers to China by the year 2000, said the newsletter, published by the Economic Daily.
It is striving for a 30 percent share of the Chinese mobile telephone market, or six millions sets, by 2000, it said without giving further details.
